$comment: F7 auto-post-approved-rules (opt-in, flag `auto-post`, off by default). The rules list is EMPTY: nothing auto-posts until you write a rule. All field names and limits are proposed, not approved. A rule: { id, target, minScore, layouts?, kinds?, maxPerDay }. kinds (default short only) lists which finished videos the rule covers: short | montage | won-reel; minScore applies to shorts only (a montage or won reel has no clip score, so naming its kind is the opt-in). minScore compares to the ranker's candidate score (data/clip/ranking.json; carried into post.json as source.score). Uploads are always private. autoUpload false = rules only mark matching drafts approved; true additionally uploads them (YouTube targets youtube-shorts and youtube-video only; the target is chosen by length and aspect from limits.json), after a run with no output live or starting.

maxPerDay.counts: auto approvals (and, separately, auto uploads) per UTC day per rule
